description: Find which years use exactly the same calendar as a given year (Gregorian, 1583 to 9999): same weekday for 1 January and same leap status, so every date falls on the same weekday. Lists the exact twins between from and to (default 1900 to 2100, at most 2,000 years apart), the nearest earlier and later twin anywhere from 1583 to 9999 (0 means there is none in that span), years that match only from 1 January to 28 February (janFebOnly) or only from 1 March to 31 December (marDecOnly), and the twins that also share Easter Sunday (sameEaster), whose Good Friday and Easter Monday line up too. jan1Weekday is a weekday name and easter is YYYY-MM-DD. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/same-calendar-year-finder/

from.description: First year of the range to list twins and partial matches in (default 1900)

to.description: Last year of the range (default 2100); to minus from can be at most 2,000

year.description: The year to match, from 1583 to 9999 (Gregorian calendar), for example 2027
